description: This file is a shell script for testing Git pre-push hooks using a test framework. It sets up various Git repository scenarios, executes pushes with hooks, and verifies hook behavior and output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specific commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after a test completes, for cleanup.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares files or output for test validation.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a given path is missing.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Function to simulate or setup Git hooks for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit for testing.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Generates or retrieves object IDs for testing.
